transparency_classification.answer: Transparent: free open-source software under MIT with no paid tier located.

evidence.title: kodo README
evidence.locator: Overview; Install; Usage; Effort levels; Custom teams; Cost tracking
evidence.finding: Overnight multi-agent coding orchestrator CLI (Python 3.13+, uv tool install kodo-agent); API or CLI-backend orchestrator delegates to installed Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Kimi and Kiro; MIT; agents run bypassPermissions; verification is orchestrator-directed, not an enforced gate.

evidence.title: Agent backend setup
evidence.locator: per-backend sections; Orchestrator API keys; Local Ollama
evidence.finding: Per-backend install/auth notes: Claude Code (Max/Pro, strips ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), Cursor, Codex (ChatGPT plan or API key), Gemini CLI, Kimi (native ACP), Kiro; orchestrator can use OpenAI, Gemini, Claude or local Ollama.

evidence.title: Running kodo for free
evidence.finding: Zero-cost route: Gemini CLI plus a free Google API key; optional Ollama orchestrator.

evidence.title: Default full team
evidence.finding: Roles worker_fast, worker_smart, tester, tester_browser, architect with backend, model, max_turns and timeout_s per agent; verifiers map lists testers, browser_testers, reviewers.

evidence.title: Custom team loading
evidence.finding: Teams load from {project}/.kodo/team.json then ~/.kodo/teams/{name}.json; agent fields backend, model, description, system_prompt, max_turns, timeout_s, chrome, fallback_model.

evidence.title: Backend registry
evidence.locator: BACKENDS dict (claude, cursor, codex, gemini-cli, kimi, kiro, opencode)
evidence.finding: Registry of seven session backends with install hints and default models; opencode is registered alongside the six README backends.

evidence.title: Orchestrator model aliases
evidence.finding: API orchestrator aliases for Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI and others via pydantic-ai, plus ollama: models against localhost:11434; per-provider API-key env var checks.

evidence.title: Environment handling
evidence.finding: ClaudeSession and ClaudeCodeOrchestrator pop ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the agent environment so Claude workers bill through the subscription.

evidence.title: Claude Code session
evidence.finding: Drives Claude Code through claude-agent-sdk with bypassPermissions; no kodo-side approval prompts.

evidence.title: Codex session
evidence.finding: Launches the codex CLI with --sandbox workspace-write by default.

evidence.title: Kimi session
evidence.finding: Native Kimi Code CLI sessions over ACP, using the CLI own auth.

evidence.title: OpenCode model isolation
evidence.finding: OpenCode session isolation pins models and tool permissions; the document states it is configuration isolation, not a sandbox for arbitrary commands.

evidence.title: Dashboard HTTP server
evidence.locator: do_GET /api/runs, /api/run/{id}/events|stream|stats; do_PUT stages; do_POST feedback, stop
evidence.finding: Local loopback web dashboard with run list, event log, SSE stream and live stats; stage plan editing via PUT; POST feedback and stop handlers are stubs (TODO comments) that only acknowledge.

evidence.title: Dashboard client
evidence.finding: Browser client for the dashboard: run list, timeline and stage views over the local REST/SSE API.

evidence.title: Run log viewer
evidence.finding: Generates or serves an interactive HTML viewer for a run log.jsonl (python -m kodo.viewer, kodo logs).

evidence.title: Git operations
evidence.finding: Creates git worktrees for parallel stages, merges branches with --no-ff, asks an agent to resolve merge conflicts, and dispatches a worker to commit after verification (never pushes).

evidence.title: Parallel stage groups
evidence.finding: Runs stages with the same parallel_group concurrently in threads, each in its own git worktree.

evidence.title: Orchestrator base
evidence.finding: Stage-group execution with KODO_MAX_PARALLEL (default 2) thread pool; end-of-run best-effort trace upload gated by KODO_TRACE_UPLOAD.

evidence.title: Verification logic
evidence.finding: done() asks tester/browser/reviewer agents to verify and parses an ALL CHECKS PASS or MINOR ISSUES FIXED signal from their text; README says this is orchestrator-directed rather than an enforced gate.

evidence.title: Coach advisor
evidence.finding: Optional --coach advisor assesses progress and can push messages; a human can append lines (priority prefixes info/warning/correction) to run_dir/human_feedback.txt, which the coach polls.

evidence.title: Trace upload
evidence.finding: Opt-in (KODO_TRACE_UPLOAD=1) upload of run directory tarballs to a maintainer-owned GCS bucket and Firestore, with secret and PII redaction.

evidence.title: Run logging
evidence.finding: Each run writes log.jsonl events under ~/.kodo/runs/<run_id>/; per-session token and cost stats with API and virtual buckets; find_incomplete_runs supports resume.

evidence.title: Agent wrapper
evidence.finding: Agent = prompt + session + turn budget with per-agent timeout; adaptive idle timeout 300 s and 75 minute hard cap.

evidence.title: Run factory
evidence.finding: Defaults of 30 exchanges per cycle and 5 cycles per run, overridable by --exchanges and --cycles.

evidence.title: Run status file
evidence.finding: Writes a structured .kodo/run-status.md progress file for the orchestrator and excludes it from Git.

evidence.title: CLI subcommands
evidence.finding: kodo runs, logs, dashboard, issue, backends, teams (list/add/edit/delete) and update subcommands.

evidence.title: CLI entry
evidence.finding: Main CLI flags and --resume that finds incomplete runs for the project.

evidence.title: CLI parameter definitions
evidence.finding: Defines --goal, --goal-file, --improve, --test, --fix-from, --team, --exchanges, --cycles, --orchestrator, --effort, --json, --resume and related flags.

evidence.title: Orchestrator types
evidence.finding: GoalStage has index, name, description, acceptance_criteria, parallel_group, persist_changes, verification; GoalPlan has shared context and ordered stages.

evidence.title: Advisor
evidence.finding: An advisor can add follow-up stages between cycles based on results.

evidence.title: Team MCP bridge
evidence.finding: kodo builds an internal MCP server exposing each team agent as a tool to a CLI orchestrator; it is a per-run stdio/SSE bridge, not a documented external API.

evidence.title: Agent dispatch tools
evidence.finding: Orchestrator tools that dispatch a task to a named agent and return its report, with unrecoverable-error patterns.

evidence.title: Session base
evidence.finding: Subprocess session base with error classification for subscription, rate-limit, billing and binary-missing failures.

evidence.title: Role prompts
evidence.finding: Prompts for orchestrator, worker, tester and architect roles including verification instructions and .kodo/test-coverage.md tracking.

evidence.title: MIT license
evidence.finding: MIT License text.

evidence.title: Package metadata
evidence.finding: kodo-agent 0.5.1, MIT, Python >=3.13, dependencies include claude-agent-sdk, pydantic-ai-slim, mcp, anthropic, detect-secrets; Beta classifier.

evidence.title: Test workflow
evidence.finding: CI matrix runs on ubuntu-latest, macos-latest and windows-latest with Python 3.13.

evidence.title: Mission and principles
evidence.finding: States unattended operation, independent verification where practical, and resumable runs as principles.

evidence.title: kodo-agent on PyPI
evidence.finding: Latest PyPI release kodo-agent 0.5.1 uploaded 2026-06-23; default-branch commits after it are unreleased.

evidence.title: GitHub repository
evidence.finding: ikamensh/kodo: 138 stars on 2026-11-17, MIT, no GitHub releases, tag 0.5.1 (2026-06-23), default branch dev, last push 2026-09-26.

evidence.title: GitHub repository API
evidence.finding: stargazers_count 138, license MIT, pushed_at 2026-09-26T08:32:04Z.

evidence.title: Maintainer post: Kodo builds while you sleep
evidence.finding: Maintainer blog post found via search; page body could not be fetched (403), so it supports only existence, not any claim.

evidence.title: bounded search: schedules and triggers
evidence.finding: No scheduler, cron, webhook or event trigger in the package; the README suggests external cron for overnight runs only.

evidence.title: bounded search: pull requests and hosting integrations
evidence.finding: No product PR creation or review-comment workflow; kodo only commits locally (never pushes) and opens a pre-filled GitHub issue URL for kodo itself.

evidence.title: bounded search: notifications
evidence.finding: No push, email, Slack or desktop notification mechanism.

evidence.title: bounded search: telemetry
evidence.finding: No analytics or telemetry SDK; the only outbound reporting is the opt-in KODO_TRACE_UPLOAD trace upload.

evidence.title: bounded search: issue tracking
evidence.finding: No product-owned issue or ticket entity; stages in a goal plan are per-run and kodo issue only files bug reports against kodo.

evidence.title: bounded search: users, roles, SSO
evidence.finding: Single-user local tool: the dashboard has no authentication or user model and binds to loopback.

evidence.title: bounded search: spend and token limits
evidence.finding: No spend or token budget enforcement; limits are turns, exchanges, cycles and timeouts.

evidence.title: bounded search: mobile and remote clients
evidence.finding: No mobile, desktop-app or remote-control client; CLI plus a loopback web dashboard.

evidence.title: bounded search: sandbox and containers
evidence.finding: Only the Codex session passes --sandbox workspace-write; Claude runs bypassPermissions; no container or VM support.

evidence.title: bounded search: external API, SDK and MCP server
evidence.finding: Python import API (Agent, Session, orchestrators) and the dashboard REST routes only; internal team MCP bridge is not exposed for other agents.

evidence.title: kodo testability.md
evidence.finding: States trace upload is disabled unless KODO_TRACE_UPLOAD=1 and, when enabled, writes run archives to GCS and Firestore; a contributor document, not the README.

evidence.title: kodo Kiro session
evidence.finding: Comment states the Kiro CLI does not report token usage, so Kiro sessions record none.

locations.result: Repository page: no roadmap file; README and mission.md state principles but no dated feature commitments.
PyPI releases 0.5.0 (2026-05-19) and 0.5.1 (2026-06-23); no release notes beyond the project page.
Open issues are bug reports filed by the maintainer testing pipeline (hive-test); no dated public announcements of planned capabilities.
Mission states unattended, resumable orchestration and deliberate product-surface growth; no dated plans.

gaps: The maintainer Medium posts returned HTTP 403 and have no Wayback copies, so any roadmap statements there were not read.
